audio.t: Hi, I'd like to apply for the low-income tuition waiver. What do I need to bring?
You'll need your household registration record and a certificate from your district office. The certificate has to be issued within the last three months.

audio.t: Attention, students. audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm Professor Huang, and I lead the department's scholarship committee. Since many of you have asked about financial support, I want to explain the three main options we offer this year. The first is the merit scholarship, which is based entirely on last semester's grades. You don't need to apply. The committee automatically selects the top five percent of each class.

The second option is the research assistant program. Students work ten hours a week in a professor's lab and receive a monthly payment. This is a great choice if you're thinking about graduate school, because you'll gain real research experience and possibly a strong recommendation letter. To apply, you'll need to submit a short proposal along with a faculty member's signature.

Finally, there's the community service grant. To be eligible, you must complete at least thirty hours of volunteer work during the semester and write a one-page reflection. Please note that you can't receive the merit scholarship and the community service grant in the same semester. If you have any questions, my office hours are on Wednesday afternoons.

questions.explain: 開頭自我介紹：I'm Professor Huang, and I lead the department's scholarship committee，故選 B。其他身分皆未提及。

A professor who leads a scholarship committee
A research lab assistant
An admissions officer

head: From: Office of Student Affairs
To: All Undergraduate Students
Subject: Work-Study Positions for the Spring Semester
passage: The Office of Student Affairs is now accepting applications for work-study positions for the spring semester. Openings are available at the library, the sports center, the IT help desk, and several academic departments. All positions pay an hourly wage and allow a maximum of fifteen hours per week.

Priority will be given to students who receive financial aid or who have a documented financial need. To apply, complete the online form on the student portal and attach your class schedule. Please note that work shifts cannot overlap with your registered classes, so make sure your schedule is accurate and up to date.
The application period runs from November 2 to November 20. Selected students will be notified by email in mid-December and must attend a two-hour training session before starting work.

Best regards,
Office of Student Affairs

questions.explain: 第一段即說明學務處開始受理下學期工讀職缺申請，主旨是公告工作機會，選 D。B 的訓練只是錄取後的細節；A、C 未提及。
options: To explain changes to financial aid rules
To invite students to a training workshop
To remind students to register for classes
To announce job opportunities for students

questions.explain: 第二段提到 work shifts cannot overlap with your registered classes，附課表是為了避免排班與上課衝突，選 B。其他選項文中都沒有提到。
options: To prove they are full-time students
To make sure work shifts do not conflict with classes

To choose a date for the training session

questions.explain: documented financial need 指「有文件證明的經濟需求」，即正式記錄在案，選 A。其餘選項意思與「有證明」無關。
options: officially recorded
widely discussed
carefully hidden
recently increased
questions.prompt: The word "documented" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to

passage: Every year, a surprising amount of scholarship money at our university goes unused. According to a recent report by the Office of Student Affairs, nearly twenty percent of available scholarship funds were not awarded last academic year. The reason was not that students were ineligible, but that too few of them applied.

Officials believe there are several causes. Many students simply do not know the scholarships exist, since information is spread across department websites, bulletin boards, and email newsletters. Others assume that only students with top grades can win. "In fact, many of our awards focus on community service, leadership, or financial need rather than grades," said Chen Yi-ting, a scholarship coordinator. "Some funds received only one or two applications."

Another barrier is the application process itself. Students interviewed for this article described forms that required multiple recommendation letters and essays, often with deadlines that fell during midterm exams. "I started an application last spring, but I gave up because I was too busy studying," said Kevin Wu, a junior in mechanical engineering.

In response, the university plans to launch a single online scholarship platform next semester. Students will be able to create one profile and be automatically matched with awards they qualify for. The office will also hold monthly workshops on writing personal statements, and several departments have agreed to move their deadlines away from exam periods.
Ms. Chen encourages students not to wait for the new system. "Even a small scholarship looks great on a resume," she said. "And you can't win if you don't apply."

questions.explain: 全文先說明獎學金無人申領的原因，再介紹學校的改善措施，選 C。B 只是措施之一的細節；A、D 未提及。
options: A new rule that limits who can apply for scholarships
How to write a strong personal statement
Why some scholarship money is not awarded and what will change
The rising cost of university tuition
questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
